tcs.tc_title: Reset Camera returns the name to the AUX Camera default
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. The head unit is an R1 Low head unit
3. Only wired AUX cameras are fitted
4. No wireless AUX feature is offered
5. A wired AUX camera is connected as AUX 1
6. The AUX 1 camera name has been edited to a name other than the default
7. The individual AUX Cam settings pop-up is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Select "Reset Camera"
2. Read the camera line item and check the name
tcs.expected_result:
1. "Reset Camera" registers the selection
2. The camera name reads "AUX Camera 1"
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.split_reason: Reset Camera returns the name to the AUX Camera default
tcs.test_item:
Reset Camera- Deletes the edited saved name of the camera, returning the name to “AUX Camera 1” or “AUX Camera 2”.(“AUX 1” and “AUX 2” on the soft controls)

(Reset Camera returns the name to the AUX Camera default)

reasoning: §34.9.2.2 之前半。預設名之逐字取該列之 `“AUX Camera 1” or “AUX Camera 2”`；本列佈 AUX 1，故 ER 判 `AUX Camera 1`。與 `-131`（§29.1.2 之 `Reset the selected camera`）之分工：後者只驗該項**被提供**（其作用當時即引本列之定義），本列驗**回復後之逐字名稱**。§34 之章標題逐字為 `R1 Low Wired AUX Cameras`（`NRL-188152`）；HU 等級**無 PROXI 編碼**（六串六本各 0 命中，CAM-17 證據 5），依 **DECISIONS 6-64** 不以此判車型，前提以散文書寫。
